nodes.label: General term of a sequence
nodes.description: Calculate terms of a sequence from its general term, and deduce the general term of a sequence from the pattern of its first few terms.

nodes.label: General term of an arithmetic sequence
nodes.description: Determine the first term and common difference of an arithmetic sequence, find missing terms, and calculate its general term and specific terms using a_n = a + (n-1)d.

nodes.label: General term from given conditions
nodes.description: Determine the general term of an arithmetic sequence from two given conditions, find which term has a given value, and use 2b = a + c when three numbers form an arithmetic sequence.

nodes.label: Sum of an arithmetic sequence
nodes.description: Calculate the sum S_n of an arithmetic sequence, including sums of a block of terms, sums of natural numbers or multiples, finding the number of terms first when unknown.

nodes.label: Use a given sum
nodes.description: Determine the number of terms or the general term from a given sum, and determine the number of terms giving the maximum sum of an arithmetic sequence.

nodes.label: General term from first term, ratio
nodes.description: Calculate the general term a_n = ar^{n-1} of a geometric sequence from its first term and common ratio or from listed terms, and find the common ratio and missing terms.

nodes.label: Terms given; b² = ac
nodes.description: Determine the general term of a geometric sequence from two given terms, and use b² = ac for three numbers in a geometric sequence, including with an arithmetic sequence.

nodes.label: Sum of n terms
nodes.description: Calculate the sum S_n of a geometric sequence of n terms using the formula for S_n.

nodes.label: First term, ratio from sums
nodes.description: Determine the first term and common ratio of a geometric sequence from conditions on a term and sums of some of its terms.

nodes.label: Write and expand Σ
nodes.description: Write a sum given with the summation symbol Σ as a sum of terms, and express a sum of terms or of a general term using Σ.

nodes.label: Evaluate sums with formulas
nodes.description: Calculate sums in terms of n using the summation properties and the formulas for constants, k, k², k³ and geometric sequences, and evaluate sums with numerical limits.

nodes.label: Sum fractional sequences
nodes.description: Calculate the sum of fractional sequences by decomposing each term into partial fractions (or rationalizing square-root denominators) and cancelling terms.

nodes.label: Sum arithmetic × geometric
nodes.description: Find the sum of the product of an arithmetic sequence and a geometric sequence using S − rS.

nodes.label: General term and sum S_n
nodes.description: Find the k-th term and the sum S_n of a sequence whose terms are themselves sums, and find the general term a_n from S_n using a_n = S_n − S_{n−1} for n ≥ 2 and a_1 = S_1.

nodes.label: General term by differences
nodes.description: Find the general term of a sequence by writing its difference sequence and using a_n = a_1 + sum of the first n-1 terms of the difference sequence, then check whether the formula holds for n=1.

nodes.label: Solving group sequence problems
nodes.description: Solve group sequence problems: divide a sequence into groups to find the first term of a given group, the sum of the terms in a group, and which group and position a given term is in.

nodes.label: Basic recurrence relations
nodes.description: Calculate terms and find the general term of a sequence given by a recurrence relation of the form a_{n+1}=a_n+d or a_{n+1}=ra_n.

nodes.label: General term from recurrences
nodes.description: Find the general term of a sequence from a_{n+1}=a_n+f(n) using the sum of the difference sequence, and from a_{n+1}=pa_n+q by solving c=pc+q and writing a_{n+1}-c=p(a_n-c) (a geometric sequence {b_n}).

nodes.label: Prove by mathematical induction
nodes.description: Prove equalities, inequalities and divisibility statements for natural numbers by mathematical induction: show n=1, then show n=k implies n=k+1.

nodes.label: Estimate and prove general term
nodes.description: Estimate the general term of a sequence defined by a recurrence relation from its first terms, and prove the estimate by mathematical induction.
